exposure: timing of hysterectomy (immediate vs. delayed) for severe placenta accreta spectrum
cohort: The study participants are patients who previously underwent a hysterectomy due to severe placenta accreta spectrum.
finding: Patients who underwent a delayed hysterectomy for severe placenta accreta spectrum were significantly more likely to report symptoms of PTSD and had higher PCL-5 scores compared to those with an immediate hysterectomy.
